title: Erdős–Rado negative stepping-up for ordinal order types
summary: A Lean 4 formalisation of the Erdős–Rado negative stepping-up lemma in its order-type form, for arities three and above and for at least two colours. Fix an ordinal kappa; a colour count mu ≥ 2; and a target order type theta = omega^alpha with alpha > 0, so that theta is additively indecomposable. The theorem proved is, for every natural number r: if some colouring of the (r+3)-subsets of kappa by ordinals below mu admits no monochromatic subset of kappa of order type theta, then some colouring of the (r+4)-subsets of 2^kappa admits none either, using the same number of colours.
